newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentine Quilmes initiated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentine Quilmes initiated as buy.

text.p: -- Santander Investment said Wednesday it initiated Argentina's Quilmes Industrial with a buy recommendation.

-- Quilmes is the third largest beverage company in terms of volume within the Mercosur customs union, which comprises Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay. It has major beer market shares in Argentina (60 percent of total sales), Paraguay (24 percent of total sales) and Uruguay (no percentage given). The brewery also owns the Coca Cola franchise in Paraguay, analyst Alexander Robarts wrote in a report.

-- "Among the six listed beverage companies operating in Argentina, Quilmes's beer brand equity, nationwide production capacity and dominant market share combine to make it the best poised to benefit from an economic recovery, in our view."
-- "An ongoing international acquisition strategy, as well as the potential to acquire minority interests at the opening level, are other sources of value," Robarts added.
-- "We view Quilmes as the beverage sector's best option for value-oriented investors seeking to participate in Argentina's and the Southern Cone's nondurable consumer growth."
-- "...We establish a 12-month price target of $13.50 per ADR, a 47 percent increase from current levels."

-- Quilmes said Monday it exercised an option to buy from Argentine group Pulenta 85 percent of brewer Cerveceria Bieckert. The option to buy Bieckert, which had a 6.5 percent share of Argentina's brewing market in 1995, values Bieckert at $40 million, including financial debt.
